name: render_get_custom_domain
description: Get one custom domain by its id or name. Returns `id`, `name`, `domainType` ('apex' | 'subdomain'), `verificationStatus` ('verified' | 'unverified'), `publicSuffix`, and `server { id name }`. Use this to check whether the domain has verified after the user set DNS. NOTE: Render does NOT return the required DNS target in this object — use `domainType` to decide the record type, then derive the value per the render-domains skill (subdomain CNAME -> the service's serviceDetails.url from render_list_services; apex A -> 216.24.57.1). Requires `serviceId` and `customDomainIdOrName` (the domain's id or the domain name itself).

customDomainIdOrName.description: The custom domain's id or its domain name (e.g. 'app.example.com').
